card.name: Linking words before baseline or study
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'at' or 'on' right after a patient condition or lab value in trial results, where 'baseline', 'study entry' or 'treatment' is expected next. Also fires partway through the word 'substudy' or after 'VISION'.

modes.label: 'at' before baseline
modes.description: The word 'at' follows a patient condition or lab value and comes just before 'baseline' or 'study entry'.
modes.example: In those patients with a normal or low TSH<< at>> baseline, an elevation of TSH was

modes.label: 'on' before a treatment or arm
modes.description: The word 'on' follows a patient or time phrase and comes before a drug or treatment arm.
modes.example: All patients treated<< on>> the docetaxel injection containing arms

modes.label: Inside study words
modes.description: Fires partway through 'substudy' or after 'VISION' when the next word is 'study'.
modes.example: In the same<< subst>>udy, invasive breast cancers were larger,

card.writes: It pushes the word 'study' and related forms as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on little words like 'at' that are about to lead into 'baseline' or 'study entry' in trial results.
